text:
maria: Heads up, the fp4 quantized bring-up shows a recall drop on several long-tail prompt families. Need a quick stratified sweep to expand golden coverage and get labeler batches out. Who can help define strata + sampling?

aj: I'm available. Which prompt families are hitting the worst regressions?

maria: Evals summary below. Mostly: multi-step math chains, conditional instructions with negations (e.g., 'don't do X'), and low-resource locales (vi, id). Also some API docs paraphrase prompts.

evals-engine: automated: run=quant-fp4-canary-2026-03-19, metric=recall@5, baseline=0.842, fp4=0.784, delta=-0.058. Top affected cohorts: ["math-chain-long", "negation-instruct", "low-resource-vi", "api-paraphrase"]. See /evals/runs/quant-fp4-canary-2026-03-19 for details.

olivia: Oof. For golden we should add ~200 examples per cohort with stratified length buckets. I can spin up labeler queue if you give sampling code and instructions.

maria: Thanks. Proposed strata: cohort x length (short <=40 tokens, mid 40-120, long >120), plus difficulty tag (single-step vs multi-step). Use dedupe at fingerprint level to avoid close variants. Sample priority: long > multi-step > low-resource.

kevin: I can prepare the sample export. Use this query to pull candidate prompts from corpus:```
SELECT id, text, locale, length(tokens) as tok_len, fingerprint
FROM prompt_corpus
WHERE cohort IN ('math-chain-long','negation-instruct','api-paraphrase','low-resource-vi')
  AND created_at < '2026-03-01'
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 5000;
```

maria: After export, run this Python sampling to stratify + dedupe (keeps first fingerprint):```
from collections import defaultdict
import csv
candidates = list(csv.DictReader(open('candidates.csv')))
by_cohort = defaultdict(list)
for r in candidates:
    by_cohort[(r['cohort'], r['tok_len_bucket'])].append(r)
samples = []
for k, v in by_cohort.items():
    seen = set()
    for r in v:
        if r['fingerprint'] in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(r['fingerprint'])
        samples.append(r)
        if len(samples) >= target_per_bucket:
            break
# write samples.csv
```

labeler-bot: Created queue: LBL-2026-0320-quant-recall-sweep, size=1200, priority=high, ttl=7d. Link: https://labeler.internal/queues/LBL-2026-0320-quant-recall-sweep

olivia: I'll attach labeling guidelines in the queue but copy here: 1) Mark ground truth answer(s) from reference set if present. 2) If ambiguous, mark "ambiguous" and include short note. 3) For multi-step math, require step verification and final numeric answer. 4) For negation prompts, include explicit check that model obeys negative constraint. Use tags: #golden, #ambiguous, #dedupe-candidate.

aj: ETA to seed the queue? I can run the sampler this afternoon and push to labeler-bot.

maria: Great. Also plan for golden update process: after labeler QC, we add 100 per cohort to golden and run regression diff. If diff persists, we escalate to rollback policy. Document: https://redwood.internal/docs/golden_update_runbook.

kevin: One more ask: when sampling, include the model logs (model A and model B outputs) so labelers can see regressions inline. Bucket format: id, text, locale, cohort, tok_len, fingerprint, baseline_output, fp4_output.

olivia: We'll need ~3 senior reviewers for the first 300 examples for GT QA. I'll ping staffing.

maria: Thanks. Priority: this is P1 for the release. If anyone spots an obvious data leak in the sampled set, flag immediately.

jeval: (typo) meant evals-engine: Quick note: low-resource cohorts are low absolute counts; consider oversampling by factor 3 to get stable estimates.

aj: Copy. I'll oversample vi/id by 3x. Running sample job now, will post candidates.csv in this thread when ready. :eyes:

kevin: Also adding a dedupe-pass using fuzzy-hash (hamming <=2) before pushing to labeler-bot.

maria: Perfect. After we get first QCed golden, schedule a short retro to decide if we need to adjust tokenization/quant kernel thresholds for those cohorts.

olivia: Understood. I'll coordinate reviewers and set up the QA rubric in the queue.

labeler-bot: Queue seeded: 1200 items, languages=[en,vi,id], flagged_cohorts=['math-chain-long','negation-instruct','api-paraphrase','low-resource-vi'].

maria: Thanks team. Keep updates here. If you need a quick sync, ping me and I'll block 30m. :thumbsup:
